commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
BRANCH='integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903'
HEAD_EXPECTED='067fa6f744f5e28233eb5b267edd7d6daa262c2c'
RUNTIME_BASE='5ce963d6ee3b03b9b788f9d02bd9acb4910acead'
TAG='c6-litegraph-migration-ready-2026-09-04'
git fetch origin "$BRANCH"
git checkout -B "$BRANCH" "origin/$BRANCH"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HEAD_EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git status --short)"
CHANGED_RUNTIME="$(git diff --name-only "$RUNTIME_BASE" "$HEAD_EXPECTED" -- CMakeLists.txt dependencies.lock main partitions.csv sdkconfig.defaults tests/host tests/zigbee_device_emulator scripts/run_host_tests.sh .github/workflows/quality.yml)"
test -z "$CHANGED_RUNTIME"
if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "tag already exists unexpectedly: $TAG" >&2
  exit 20
fi
git tag -a "$TAG" "$HEAD_EXPECTED" -m 'C6 LiteGraph migration-ready freeze'
git push origin "refs/tags/$TAG"
REMOTE_TAG="$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG^{}" | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$REMOTE_TAG" = "$HEAD_EXPECTED"
echo FINAL_MIGRATION_TAG="$TAG"
echo FINAL_FREEZE_HEAD="$HEAD_EXPECTED"
echo HARDWARE_PROVEN_RUNTIME_SOURCE="$RUNTIME_BASE"
echo FINAL_TAG_GATE=PASS
